purpose: Pre-registered sampling rule for RERUN's Batch Lab. Everything the draw depends on is fixed here and committed BEFORE the draw runs.

datasets.source: Papers with Code archive on Hugging Face (last public snapshot of paperswithcode-data)
datasets.why: Papers with Code was the standard paper->official-code index and records venue (`proceeding`) and an `is_official` flag per link; paperswithcode.com itself was shut down in 2025, so its public archive is used at a pinned revision.
datasets.access: DuckDB read_parquet over hf:// at the pinned revisions with column projection and pushed-down filters; the full parquet files are not downloaded.

frame.proceeding_note: Main-track labels only: venue + one year (+ optional month). Excludes workshop, track, tiny-paper, blog and malformed labels (e.g. 'NeurIPS 2022 2022 12').
frame.unit: paper (paper_url); a paper with several official GitHub repos uses the lexicographically smallest repo_url
frame.known_coverage_bias: The archive's main-track labels are very uneven: ICML 2019/2021/2022 and NeurIPS 2022 are nearly absent (single digits to ~16 papers), so the frame is effectively ICLR 2018-2022, NeurIPS 2018-2021 and ICML 2018/2020. Reported, not corrected.

eligibility.E2_official_code: is_official link to a github.com repository (in the frame)
eligibility.E3_reachable: `git ls-remote --exit-code <repo>.git HEAD` succeeds; that HEAD sha is pinned as commit_sha at draw time (GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0: a repo needing credentials fails immediately instead of prompting)
eligibility.E5_documented_command: the root README (first of README.md, README.rst, README, readme.md, Readme.md, README.MD, README.txt that exists at the pinned commit) contains, in reading order, a line matching the command regex (after stripping prompt markers $ > % # ! and backticks, joining backslash continuations) whose script (`python|python3|bash|sh <path>.py|.sh`) or module (`python -m <mod>` -> <mod>.py or <mod>/__main__.py) exists at the pinned commit, and that contains no placeholder. The FIRST such line is recorded verbatim as the corpus command (ground truth).
eligibility.not_required: CPU feasibility, runtime, data availability — those are measured by RERUN, not screened.
eligibility.limitation: Only the root README is searched (not docs/), to keep the check deterministic and within GitHub's unauthenticated API budget (one API call per candidate).

draw_procedure: random.Random(seed).shuffle(list(range(len(population)))) in CPython; screen in that order; a repo already drawn for another paper is skipped as a duplicate; stop at target_eligible eligible entries or when the population is exhausted (then report the achieved N). No manual exclusions or replacements; every draw is logged with its pass/fail reason in screening_log.jsonl.
rate_limits: GitHub API 403/429 with remaining=0: wait until the reset time and retry the same candidate (does not change the order). HF 429 during population build: retry with backoff.
corpus_hash_definition: sha256 of canonical JSON {prereg_sha256, entries sorted by name with name, repo_url, commit_sha, command}
